# exo_mailbox_audit_bypass_association (Resource)

Manages the MailboxAuditBypassAssociation configuration via Set-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `audit_bypass_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -AuditBypassEnabled parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
